answer_1.quote: In this work, we ... fine-tune GPT-3 on an automatic post-editing task in which the model attempts to transform an MT output into a human reference translation.
answer_1.outputs: paragraph-level English translations generated from source-language literary paragraphs

answer_2.quote: We address deficiencies in existing automatic MT evaluation metrics, including BLEU, BLEURT, and the document-level BLONDE metric. These metrics failed to distinguish human from machine translation, even preferring the MT outputs on average.

answer_4.quote: We administer A/B tests to two sets of raters: (1) monolingual English experts ... and (2) professional literary translators ... We asked each rater to choose the "better" translation and also to give written justification for their choice (2-3 sentences).
answer_4.guideline: Raters were asked to choose the better translation and provide a brief written justification for their choice.
